## Introduction 

Grab MERSCOPE codebook. Must have row names in the first column giving species names. 

```{r get_codebook}
file_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "codebook_obs.csv",
  package = "flipFISH"
)
codebook <- read.csv(file_path, row.names = 1)
```

Some text here. 

```{r set_max_Hamming}
max_correctable_Hamming_distance <- 3
```

Get summary stats 


```{r make_count_data, eval = FALSE}
data_path_cells <- "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/_molecular_mechanisms_of_ACx_lateralization/data_ACx_cells"
count_data <- wispack::make_count_data(
  data_path = data_path_cells, 
  remove_L1 = FALSE, 
  ROI_only = FALSE,
  raw = TRUE,
  drop_blanks = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
count_data <- count_data$count_data
```

Now make summary stats, for each mouse 

```{r summary_stats, eval = FALSE}
mice <- unique(count_data$mouse)
mice_masks <- lapply(mice, function(m) count_data$mouse == m)
count_data <- count_data[,13:(ncol(count_data)-6)]
summary_stats_data <- data.frame(mouse = c(), rates = c(), variance = c(), counts = c())
for (i in seq_along(mice_masks)) {
  ss <- summary_stats_from_data(count_data[mice_masks[[i]],])
  ss <- cbind(mouse = i, ss)
  summary_stats_data <- rbind(summary_stats_data, ss)
}
write.csv(
  summary_stats_data,
  file = "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/R_packages/flipFISH/inst/extdata/summary_stats_all_mice.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```

```{r align_names}
file_path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "summary_stats_all_mice.csv",
  package = "flipFISH"
)
summary_stats_data <- read.csv(file_path, row.names = 1)

m1_summary_stats <- summary_stats_data[summary_stats_data$mouse == 1,]
rownames(codebook) <- gsub("-", ".", rownames(codebook))

```

Now try new function. 

```{r test}
# Parameters
max_fr    <- 0.1
max_corr  <- 0.2
rate10_scale <- 0.2
initial_corr <- 0.01
n_forks   <- 4

# Derived dimensions
N_bits    <- ncol(codebook)
corr_free <- N_bits * (N_bits - 1) / 2

# Convert data frames to matrices as required by mQC_init
bc_count_mat <- as.matrix(m1_summary_stats)
codebook_mat <- as.matrix(codebook)
storage.mode(codebook_mat) <- "integer"

init <- mQC_init(
  bc_count_mat,
  codebook_mat,
  as.integer(max_correctable_Hamming_distance),
  max_fr       = max_fr,
  initial_corr = initial_corr,
  rate10_scale = rate10_scale,
  n_forks      = n_forks
)

obj <- function(p) mQC_msle(p, init$data_ptr)

result <- optim(
  par    = init$params,
  fn     = obj,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower  = c(rep(0,                    2 * N_bits),
             rep(-max_corr,            2 * corr_free)),
  upper  = c(rep(max_fr * rate10_scale,    N_bits),
             rep(max_fr,                   N_bits),
             rep(max_corr,             2 * corr_free)),
  control = list(trace = 1, REPORT = 1)
)
```

```{r new_initial_estimate}

t <- Sys.time()
qc <- misreadQC(
    m1_summary_stats, # Numeric matrix with rows as barcodes, columns labeled "rates", "variance", "counts", must have barcode names as row names
    codebook, # Codebook with row names as barcodes and columns as bits, must have barcode names as row names
    max_fr = 0.1,
    max_corr = 0.2,
    rate10_scale = 0.2,
    initial_corr = 0.05,
    n_steps = 10,
    n_forks = 4,
    step_size_range = c(0.1, 0.005), # max and min step size for MCMCSA, will be decayed linearly over n_steps
    temp_range = c(0.25, 0.05), # max and min temperature for MCMCSA, will be decayed linearly over n_steps
    corr_step_scale = 1.0, # step size for correlation will be scaled by this factor relative to other parameters
    max_correctable_Hamming_distance = NULL,
    ran_seed = 12345
    )
d <- Sys.time() - t
units(d) <- "secs"
cat("\ntime:", d, "seconds\n")
```

```{r plot_results}
plot.PPV(qc)
plot.counts(qc)
plot.fr(qc)
plot(qc$msle, type = "l")
```
